item.title: Clearwater woman said 'white supremacy group' would shoot up Black church on Easter: SPPD
item.description: A Clearwater woman was arrested Monday after she was accused of threatening a mass shooting at a church in St. Petersburg.

item.title: VIDEO: Florida deputies rearrest wanted Ohio man on parole for son's murder
item.description: Volusia County deputies arrested a man on Daytona Beach on March 21, who was wanted out of Ohio for violation of parole after he pleaded guilty to involuntary manslaughter in the death of his 2-month-old son, according to authorities.

item.title: Lawsuit challenges new Florida version of SAVE America Act

item.title: Conservationists push back against Trump admin vote to allow offshore drilling in Gulf

item.title: Stetson alumni call on college to create 'distance' from Bondi after she was ousted as Attorney General
